en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, in an unbroken chain, said,

‘Do not be taking anyone from besides Allah<sup>azwj</sup> as a confidant, for you would not happen to be Momineen. Every means, and lineage, and relationship, and confidant and it’s like would be cut off except for what the Quran has affirmed’.
en.sarwar: 22. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father in mursal manner (Mursalan) from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Do not take anyone closely and intimately between your selves and Allah lest you will not be believers.
Every means, ancestral and relative relations and intimacy, innovations and doubts will be cut off except for what is established in the holy Quran.”
